**Problem:** Several coin-cache fixtures use `EmplaceCoinInternalDANGER` just to set up their coins, even though it is reserved for snapshot loading.

**Fix:** Use `AddCoin` and `SpendCoin` for fixture setup, keeping the entries dirty but not fresh, as before. Keep the [simulation](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/33512), [fuzz and duplicate-insertion coverage](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32313) that intentionally tests the bypass.

This is a small extraction from #36598 that can be reviewed and merged independently of the broader AssumeUTXO removal demo. The overlay fixture change also follows the earlier [suggestion in #35295](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35295#discussion_r3421846300).
